overview.description: The Columbia Short Duration High Yield ETF (HYSD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund actively invests in corporate debt securities and floating rate loans rated below investment grade. The fund aims to have a dollar-weighted average effective maturity of five years or less. HYSD was launched on Sep 5, 2024 and is issued by Columbia Threadneedle.
